title: Cracking the code on total talent: real strategies for real results.
summary: Explore how companies like Danaher leverage total talent strategies to improve hiring outcomes through technology, data, and collaboration in this insightful webinar.
body_markdown:
Is “total talent” just a buzzword or the key to your future workforce strategy? In this webinar with Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA), you’ll learn how forward-thinking companies like Danaher are aligning procurement and talent acquisition (TA) to drive successful outcomes — powered by technology, data, and collaboration.


Discover how to:


- Break down internal silos to facilitate a true total talent vision
- Align contingent and full-time hiring strategies across departments
- Leverage data and tech to enhance visibility and decision-making
- Drive better outcomes for hiring managers and candidates


**Amy Bush** , president, RPO,


KellyOCG + Sevenstep


Allen Chilson , director, TA management,


Danaher


[Peter Reagan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/peterreagan/) , senior director, CWS Council,
